text:
anna: Heads-up: planning a gradual ramp for runtime v2 on hosted next Tue 10:00 PDT. Goal: 0% -> 5% -> 20% -> 50% over 90m with smoke checks at each step. Who can own the deploy and smoke?
michael: I can do deploy and initial smoke. please add the post-deploy perf checks to the runbook.
anna: thx. michael — can you confirm the exact cohort definitions? thinking: cohort A = 1% random, B = 4% random (so A+B = 5%), then 15% targeted to europe, then 30% global. open to tweaks.
olivia: prefer to avoid region-only step unless latency SLOs differ. suggestion: 5% global -> 20% global -> 50% global. keeps routing simpler.
dinesh: memory/kv cache behavior changed in v2. we should gate the 20% step with a smoke pipeline that verifies tail latency and kv hit rate. I'll add two quick monitor queries.
sara: We need rollback tags ready. rollback image = `runtime-v1.12.3` and canary tag `runtime-v2-canary-2026-03-24`. Add `rollback-ready` label to the deploy PR.
michael: Timeline: deploy at 10:00 PDT, wait 10m for 5% step, run quick smoke (3 checks), then at +25m bump to 20%, wait 20m, bump to 50% at +60m if green. OK?
anna: OK. what are the 3 quick smoke checks?
michael: 1) 95th p99 < 250ms for gen endpoint (1k sample) 2) error rate < 0.1% 3) kv hit-rate > 85% for prefix-heavy traces. I'll paste the queries in a sec.
dinesh: queries: `sum(rate(http_server_errors[5m]))/sum(rate(http_requests_total[5m]))` and `histogram_quantile(0.95, sum(rate(request_duration_seconds_bucket[5m])) by (le))` and `sum(kv_hits[10m])/sum(kv_requests[10m])`. tweak if needed.
olivia: I can run smoke for +20 step. michael does initial 5%. dinesh will watch kv metrics and run manual cache flush if needed.
sara: Ops checklist: ensure canary alerting is unmuted, paging for SRE if p99 spike >350ms. set rollout notes in the release PR `#gradual-ramp-2026-03-24`.
deploy-bot: Deploy scheduled by michael to hosted cluster `us-west-2` at 2026-03-24T17:00:00Z (10:00 PDT). Canary plan: 5%, 20%, 50%. Rollback tag: runtime-v1.12.3.
michael: I'll post the smoke query results in this thread after each step. tagging @olivia for 20% and @dinesh for kv watch.
anna: one more: lock autoscaler to manual during the 90m window to avoid noisy scaling. @eng-infra fyi.
dinesh: noted — I'll apply `autoscaler.mode=manual` 5m before deploy and revert after final step.
olivia: got it. good to go from me.
sara: Approved from product side for traffic shaping. good luck :thumbsup:
michael: starting deploy prep now, will update here when pushed.
